scenario.name: Dead end in the open
scenario.heading: N
scenario.expected: Goes forward to (4,2), where front, left, and right are blocked. Stops for ticks 3-7, then moves backward for ticks 8-12 to (4,7). There both sides are open, so it turns right for ticks 13-17 and goes forward east with cleaning from tick 18. Clean is Stop from tick 3 to tick 17.
